byang sems bkra shis 'od zer gyis re ltos bla ma las med par kho thag chod pa'i rang mtshangs sun 'byin gyi tshul du gdung glu bzhengs pa ni/bdag blo'i snya

tei:div.tei:p: #! byang sems bkra shis 'od zer gyis re ltos bla ma las med par kho thag chod pa'i rang mtshangs sun 'byin gyi tshul du gdung glu bzhengs pa ni/ bdag blo'i snying gi pad+ma 'dab brgyad ze'u 'bru yi gdan gyi// dwangs ma lnga 'dus thig le thabs shes nyi zla yi dkyil na// skyabs gsum kun 'dus ngo bo bka' drin mtshungs med kyi 'dren mchog /rtsa ba'i bla ma gang de 'bral med rtag pa ru bzhugs shig /pha gcig sangs rgyas kun 'dus thugs mchog dmigs med kyi snying rjes// bden gnyis dam chos kun 'dus zab mo gsung gsang gi bdud rtsi// rig grol dge 'dun kun 'dus zhi sku ngur smrig gi rol pas// dngos su bdag la stsol mdzad rtsa ba'i bla ma de mkhyen no// yon tan bkod pa phun tshogs rnam dag rab 'byams kyi zhing na// stobs bcu'i yon tan mnga' ba'i sangs rgyas du ma zhig bzhugs shing*// cho 'phrul rnam pa mang pos chos sgo mtha' yas zhig ston kyang*// ma dag las kyi sgrib pas bdag gis mthong chos tsam mi 'dug /grangs med rgyal bas spangs pa'i mi mjed 'jig rten gyi gnas 'dir// rnam lnga snyigs ma'i yang snyigs nyes pa brgya phrag gi gong bur// dman pa bdag la brtse ba'i snying stobs rmad byung gi dpa' bo// sangs rgyas stong las lhag pa'i 'dren mchog bla ma de dran no// de yi sku gsung thugs kyi thun mong rnam thar tsam gzhig cing*// rang gi lus ngag yid kyi bsam sbyor ma rungs par brtags na// dad dang skyo ba'i dbang gis mchi ma dbang med du 'khrugs shing*// dbyer med gcig tu thim snyam skabs rer rtogs pa zhig 'char rung*// kun dkris nyon mongs btsan pos shog dril rang lam gyi dpe ltar// dug gsum rkyen gyis bkar bas dman pa rang sa ru lus shing*// mi dran dgu dran bsam pas mi byed dgu byed du spyod 'di// drin can bla mas dgongs te bdag la chad pa zhig mthong mdzod// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin yon tan thams cad kyi rmang gzhi// gnang bkag tshul bzhin spyod pa'i tshul khrims kho na la rag na// sna gcig srung ba med par chos gos lhung bzed cig bzung nas// dge sbyor yin mdog kha la bka' bkyon mi mdzad pa 'di ci// nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub pa'i dbang po las skyes shing*// thub mchog zab rgyas spyod pa'i rgyal sras sems dpa' las 'khrungs na// rang 'dod khong la bcug nas gzhan phan bshad yam du lus pa'i// rgyu med 'bras bur 'dod la phyag 'bebs mi gnang ba 'di ci// thabs mang dka' ba med par gsang sngags dbang rnon gyi khyad chos// dam tshig ngo lkog med par rim gnyis zab mo la brtson na// tshe gcig bar do ma'am ste skye ba bcu drug las mi 'da'// rdo rje 'chang dngos 'grub rung nyams len dwangs ma ni mi gda'// chos brgyad srog ltar gnyer ba'i phyi tshul ngur smrig la brdzu nas// rang rgyud gyong rung lus bzhin bla ma'i ming snyan du rlom pa// gzig lpags bkab pa'i bong ltar tha ma rang phung las med na// da lta nyid du bla mas gnas dbyung mi mdzad pa 'di ci// dal 'byor thob dka' shes kyang de las snying po ni mi len// mi rtag 'chi ba shes kyang nam 'chi cha med ni mi dran// bde sdug sngon las shes kyang dge sdig blang dor ni mi byed// 'khor ba sdug bsngal nges kyang nges 'byung bsam pa ni mi 'dug

/kyi hud bdag 'dra'i zog po bzang mdog phye tshul can 'di yis// skal mnyam bslu nges 'dug go shes ldan skye bo dag mkhyen la// kha bshad mkhas mkhas tshig dang spyod lam mdzes mdzes la ma gzigs// mi bden ngo ma thag chod nang mgo phyir btsong gi snying gtam// kye ma bdag gi mgon gcig mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi bdag nyid// mkhyen par chags thogs med na bdag blo lkog gyur 'di mkhyen mdzod// brtse bar nye ring med na skyon can btang snyoms su ma bzhag /nus pa drag po yod na myur bar rgyud ngan 'di brlag mdzod// 'di mus ngan lam btang na sems dpa' chen po ni mchog gis// 'gro kun thar par drangs kyang ma rungs kho bo cag gcig pur// ched du 'o brgyal mdzad dgos gting zab dmyal ba yi dong nas// gdon dka' 'byung nges 'dug go la 'ur thugs rje 'dir ma chung*// re sa khyed las med na gdung yus mi 'bod ni ka med// bdag ni dbang med lags na nyams len rtsal shed ni ma rdzogs// nyon mongs dbang btsan 'di ni yul lngar zhen spyod kyi btung bas// lus stobs rab tu brtas te bdag nyid bran g.yog la bkol 'dug /'dul skyong nyid kyis mdzad pa'i lang tsho dar ba zhig byung zhing*// dpa' bo 'thab pa'i lag cha shes rab ral gri zhig gnang na// pho ngan stong bshad min pa'i kha bshad lag len du thebs nges// 'di byas sne gcig yod pa'i dam bca' da lta nas 'bul lo// zhes pa 'di ni rang gi bsam sbyor la yid ma ches pa'i smyo glu ngu tshab tu ban+de maṅga lar smis bris pa dge/ ༈ mkhan chen bla ma rin po ches snyigs dus kyi spyod pa la yid skyo zhing gong ma'i rnam thar ngo mtshar ba'i mgur glu bzhengs pa ni/ na mo gu ru/ gnas rang snang rnam dag gi zhing khams su// pha rang rig don gyi bla ma la// bdag 'khor 'das ro snyoms su gsol ba 'debs// don 'khor ba dong sprugs su byin gyis rlobs// rje gsang chen rigs gcig dang po'i mgon// dpal drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen nas// pha bka' brgyud kyi rnam thar dran tsa na// yid ngan rtog gi rgyu ba rang sar 'gag

/mtshan snyan pa'i ba dan srid gsum khyab// mgon bka' brgyud gong ma'i zhen log gis// rten dal 'byor nyin mo'i skar ma 'di'i// gnas lus dang longs spyod 'byor ba kun// sang 'chi ba srog dang bral ba'i tshe// dpe rmi lam sad pa'i nangs mo ltar// kun slog rul bzhin du bor nas su// rang gcig pur gshin rje'i grong yul du// 'jigs nyam thag gi sdug bsngal 'byung gzigs nas// dpe ri dwags dgra la 'jigs pa ltar// don chos brgyad kyi thal ba rlung la bskur// tshe 'di la zhen pa'i gdos thag bcad// de e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// dus deng sang snyigs ma'i skye bo kun// tshe 'dir snang gi zhen pa me ltar 'bar// chos gang byas chos brgyad kyi thob shor bkye// 'chi ba mi rtag de ma dran yid re skyo// dus skad cig bsags pa'i las ngan gyis// 'bras mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal sogs// lo stong phrag du mar myang gzigs nas// dpe dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas ltar// gnas phun tshogs srid pa'i bde 'byor dang*// las 'dod yon la zhen pa'i gdos thag bcad// de e ma ngo mtshar= dus deng sang bdag 'dra'i las ngan rnams// grogs 'dod yon spu gri'i sbrang rtsir chags// sdig mi dge'i dug chu sman ltar 'thungs// las rgyu 'bras 'di mi srung yid re skyo// spyir rigs drug 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ru// sdug bsngal ba'i rba klong rab tu 'khrugs// las mtha' med kyi nyes chen 'di gzigs nas// dpe bya rgod rgya las shor ba ltar// gnas 'khor ba la zhen pa'i gdos thag bcad// de e ma ngo mtshar= dus deng sang bdag 'dra'i zog po kun// gzhi 'khor ba la zhen pa ma log pas// chos byas tshad sdug bsngal gyi 'bras bu can// don bsam tshad chags sdang 'phel ba'i rgyu// blo nges 'byung 'di ma goms yid re skyo// rje bka' brgyud gong ma'i gzhan phan gyis// mtha' nam mkhas khyab pa'i sems can rnams// drin pha mar ma gyur gcig kyang med// des tshab chen gyi sdug bsngal myong gzigs nas// dpe dgra stabs mkhas pa'i dpa' bo yi// bu snying sdug g.yul du lus pa 'dra'i// byams snying rje byang chub sems 'byongs nas// ma 'gro ba yongs kyi gtan don mdzad// rang zhi bder zhen pa'i gdos thag bcad// 'di zhen log sgom gyi rkang par bzhed// de e ma ngo mtshar=

dus deng sang tshul 'chos bdag 'dra rnams// gdon bdag 'dzin gyi mgo 'phang dgung bas mtho// chos kha bshad kyi lhag bsam 'ja' ltar yal// don rang rgyud dul ba bong bu'i rwa// phyogs dgra gnyen chags sdang gi 'khrul 'khor gyis// khe gsog 'jog bun skyed mgo bskor sogs// byams snying rje'i dri tsam ring du brlag /lam byang sems 'di ma goms yid re skyo// pha bka' brgyud gong ma'i dag snang gis// rje bla ma sangs rgyas dngos su blta// bka' gang stsal srog la thug kyang sgrub// res 'byor rgud kyi skyid sdug ci byung yang*// blo gcig chod kyi 'dun pa ling gis bkal// lam mos gus bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// dag snang gi rtog pa lam du khyer// chos phyag rgya chen po 'bad med rtogs// 'di mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor bzhed// de e ma= dus deng sang bdag 'dra'i dred po rnams// chos zab dgu ston pa'i bla ma yang*// mi phal pa so so'i skye bor zung*// las dang po'i dad mos tshab tshub kyang*// blo rang mtshangs the tshom gyi ling thog gis// yid mos gus kyi mig bzang rim gyis 'grib// sgom lo zla bzhin rang rgyud phyi phyir gyong*// las dmu rgod kyi ngan spyod yi re skyo// rje grub thob yongs kyi zab lam gyis// chos 'khor 'das lam gyi snang lugs kun// gshis ya babs kyi klong du yin lugs gcig /gzhi mtha' bral lta ba'i sgro 'dog bcad// de e ma= chos gang shar mi 'gog thabs kyi lam// don stong chen sher phyin yum gyi klong*// lam zung 'jug mnyam nyid chen por gdal// de e ma= bzang stong gsal bde chen nyams kyi 'gyur// gdangs 'gag med kyi chags zhen ras su bor// gshis byar med kyi ro snyoms thang du lhug /de e ma= ngan tshogs drug 'khrul rtog gi yo lang sogs// rtsal sna tshogs rig stong chos sku'i 'od// la gzhi gnas zang thal gyi klong du zlo// de e ma=

yid nyon mongs dug lnga'i skyes bu de// lam gtum mo 'bar 'dzag gi rta la drangs// babs bde chen gyi thang du kha yan glod// de e ma= sems snang gsum dkar dmar rlung gi mgron// gnad sbyor ba bzhi ldan gyi rta la drangs// rtsa dbu ma'i thang du kha yan glod// de e ma= btsan 'khrul snang las kyi rgyal po de// skabs gti mug gnyid kyi rta la drangs// gshis 'od gsal gyi thang la kha yan glod// de e ma= lar snang grags rtog tshogs kyi rol pa kun// lam smin grol mgyogs pa'i rta la drangs// zhing snang srid dag mnyam chen por glod// de e ma= yul 'khor 'das sems kyi rol par shar// sems dmigs gtad kyi mtshan ma dbyings su yal// dbyings zung 'jug gi klong du rgya yan 'byams// sgom mi sgom gyi bya rtsol blo las 'das// lam gol shor dang bral ba'i phyag rgya che// 'di yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir mdzad// de e ma= pha bka' brgyud gong ma'i spyod lam du// gnas g.ya' brag gangs kyi lding gur 'grim// gos reg 'jam gtum mo'i bde drod sbar// tshogs zag med ting 'dzin gyi zas la rol// de e ma= rdzun kun rdzob sgyu ma'i grong khyer du// yid re dogs bdud kyi cho 'phrul la// rig pa ro snyoms kyi brtul zhugs spyod// de e ma= phyi 'gal rkyen thob babs kyi lhong tshad dang*// nang 'jigs skrag nyam nga'i 'phrang chen la// sems 'jigs bral thog rdzis kyi brtul zhugs spyod// de e ma= yul 'khrul snang rmi lam gyi rgyal khams su// blo gza' gtad dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor gyis// nyams thug phrad kyi snang ba lam du khyer// skyo dga' brod snyems byed kyi khu 'phrigs dang*// bdag mchog 'dzin gyi rlom sems ar la gtad// 'di dgag sgrub dang bral ba'i spyod par bzhed// de e ma= nang 'khrul ba'i mtshangs chen dbyings su dib// sems chos sku'i rgyal sa zin pa'i rtags// phyi snang srid 'khor 'das rang dbang sgyur// gsung mdo rgyud man ngag gi mgur dbyangs 'then// sku rdzu 'phrul ya ma zung du ston// dma' dal 'bab kyi chu la nya ltar 'phyo// bar sra mkhregs kyi brag la zang thal spyod// mtho dgung sngon gyi dbyings su bya ltar lding*// ya mtshan gyi grub rtags bsam las 'das// de e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// mchog gsang chen theg pa'i myur lam gyis// gshis 'od gsal chos sku'i sgrib g.yog bral// tshe gcig la zung 'jug gi gtan srid bzung*// phrin las kyis 'grau khams yongs la khyab// bka' brgyud pa nor bu'i phreng tshom ltar// 'di sangs rgyas sems las rnyed par bzhed// de e ma=

chos zab dgu'i khyad chos de ltar yang*// kye ma la bdag 'dra'i las ngan rnams// nyin 'khrul snang thob shor gyi bya bas brel// mtshan gti mug ro nyal gyi dbang du song*// sang hur thag dbugs kyis bstung ba'i tshe// don 'di grub kyi 'dzin mtshams gcig kyang med// las ngan gyi rnam smin ri bas lji// blo phyi 'gyod kyi mya ngan me ltar 'bar// lam phyag chen 'di ma bsgoms yid re skyo// da tshe 'di'i lhag ma cung zad 'di// gnas nyams dga' dben pa'i ri klung du// pha bka' brgyud gong ma'i rnam thar bzhin// bdag snying po'i don la 'dril bar shog /ces pa 'di ni khyung po ba mkhyen rab phun tshogs kyi ngor phyogs med kyi rgyal khams nyul ba'i dus su ban+de maṅga las nyams mtshar gyi tshul du smras pa dge/ //
